prompt.project_info: Environmental lifestyle portrait framed through an open car window on a rainy day.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with shoulder-length warm medium-brown hair, natural makeup and berry-red lipstick, wearing a dark green cap, round sunglasses, and oversized dark jacket; leaning out of the car window with forearms resting on the door and looking off-camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium close-up, subject center-left, horizontal car-door and window-frame lines, strong separation from fully blurred dense green foliage, raindrops on vehicle exterior.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused overcast ambient light, subtle hair highlights, soft shadows, muted forest-green and charcoal palette, calm introspective urban-casual cinematic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Portrait lens 50-85mm look, wide aperture f/1.8-f/2.8, clean low-noise image, frozen raindrops, creamy bokeh, slightly desaturated cool shadows and warm highlights.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical photorealistic cinematic lifestyle portrait of one generic approved adult woman leaning from an open car window with forearms on the door, wearing a dark green cap, round sunglasses and oversized dark jacket, warm brown hair and berry lipstick, rainy dense green foliage behind, soft overcast light, creamy bokeh and muted tones.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed hands, unreadable cap logo, watermark, logo overlay

assets.name: rainy-window-cinematic-portrait.jpg
assets.usage: Match adult subject, cap, sunglasses, jacket, lean-out pose, rainy car, foliage, framing, and muted cinematic light.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve identity, hair, expression, accessories, pose, car geometry, weather, composition, and lighting. Cap typography is replaceable; keep it garment-integrated and avoid logos or overlay text.

changes: Normalized schema and added safety/reference guidance.
